newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dave & Busters estimates up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dave & Busters estimates up.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Friday it raised its estimate for Dave & Busters Inc's fourth quarter earnings to $0.30 a share from $0.27 and the estimate for all of fiscal 1996 to $0.89 from $0.86.

-- Hanifen said the company plans to accelerate its development schedule in 1997, adding that Dave & Busters plans to open at least four combination restaurant/entertainment centers a year beginning in 1998.
-- The company also announced revenues for the fourth quarter of 1996 will be about $27 million, $2.5 million ahead of Hanifen's estimate.
-- Dave & Busters shares closed down 1/4 Friday at 22-3/4.
